kill.h2: 理论明确列出：哪些实验结果将直接证伪或迫使物理主张改写。
kill.intro: 本框架不借助连续拟合参数微调数值以迎合实验。一旦关键观测与推算相悖，必须公开更正推导谬误，或撤回受影响的主张及依赖它的物理结论。下方列出专著中最关键的六项实验检验，逐一写明承测实验、预计时间窗、明确的证伪条件以及失效波及范围。
kill.registryStatus: 以下六项代表本研究计划最锋利的实验判决赌注，均摘自专著。公开预测登记系统已就绪，当前含 0 项预注册预测。
kill.gradeIntro: 不同证伪结果所动摇的范围并不相同，共分三级：
gradeKey: 若确立倒序或测得正值 CP 相位，则相关核心物理主张与依赖链全体失效，物理实现机制须重新审视；有限系统层面的纯数学命题仍须另作分别评估。
若探测到 QCD 轴子或观测到质子衰变，属于这一层级：意味着必须重建一套截然不同的规范力架构。
产生该具体数值的特定理论分支宣告失效，但较宽广的外围框架未必随之全部失效。例如无中微子双 β 衰变偏离点值，或 θ₂₃ 落入下卦限均属此级。

cards.claim: 三种中微子的轻重排序在本框架内由结构导出，而非人为输入。其中两个质量相近的本征态位于底部，孤立本征态位于顶部——即正常质量顺序（Normal Ordering）；在选定分支下，最轻中微子质量严格为零。至于相近本征态位于顶部的倒序排列，在模型内部受到严格禁止而非仅仅偏好较低。
cards.threshold: 若实验确证中微子为倒序质量排列，正常序主张及所有依赖该前提的物理结论立即失效。
cards.note: JUNO 已于 2025 年 8 月正式开始取数，并于同年 11 月发布首批物理成果。DUNE 目前计划于 2029 年启用首台远端探测器，2031 年获得加速器束流。冻结的 v2.0 专著所引用的全局拟合仅微弱倾向正常序，属于历史数据对照，不代表最终判决。
cards.check: 在 c_R = 1 的跷跷板分支下推出正常序；倒序排除定理见宇宙学读出附录。详见审阅问题 6。

cards.h3: 中微子 CP 相位符号
cards.claim: 中微子与反中微子振荡行为的差异由 Dirac CP 相位 δ_CP 主导。本框架将其代数取值严格限制为 +90° 或 −90°，并由现实宇宙“正物质多于反物质”的观测事实唯一锁定：实验室测得的 CP 符号与宇宙重子不对称度符号满足刚性约束 sign(sin δ_CP) × sign(η_B) = −1。因我们的宇宙由正物质构成（η_B > 0），故 sin δ_CP 必须为负。
cards.threshold: 若实验确认 sin δ_CP 为正号，符号锁定主张及全套依赖结论立即失效。
cards.note: 至于为何正物质一侧胜出，理论本身并不作先验推导——作者已逐层证明定律对正反两面盲视，故正物质主导属于真空自发选定的历史结果。理论所约束的是上述两符号之间的联动关系，这正是 DUNE 与 Hyper-K 将直接检验的焦点。冻结版专著引用的 NuFIT 6.0 约 214°（偏离约 1.6 σ）属历史对照；NuFIT 6.1 在两套大气数据方案下的正常序最佳拟合值分别为 207° 或 212°，两者的 3 σ 区间均仍包含 270°，目前仍无定论。
cards.check: 《内部观察者》附录“重子—狄拉克符号锁定定理”；《实真空》一章“自发取向”注记。详见审阅问题 C。

cards.h3: 混合角 θ₂₃ 的卦限
cards.claim: 刻画第二代与第三代中微子混合强度的混合角 θ₂₃，在本框架内算得 sin²θ₂₃ = 4/7 ≈ 0.5714，严格落于大于 1/2 的上卦限（upper octant）。
cards.threshold: 若未来实验明确确立 θ₂₃ 处于下卦限（sin²θ₂₃ < 1/2），则本分支推导即遭证伪。
cards.note: 冻结的 v2.0 专著曾引用包含超级神冈大气数据的全局拟合（当时最佳拟合落于下卦限，而上卦限解仍位于允许区间内）。此属历史数据状况，目前卦限判断须待新一轮拟合及束流实验检验。
cards.check: 伴随载体符号选择引理；《预言》一章 PMNS 混合参数表。详见审阅问题 6。

cards.h3: 无中微子双 β 衰变（m_ββ）
cards.claim: 本框架中的中微子为马约拉纳粒子（即自身的反粒子），因而特定原子核可发生不发射中微子的双 β 衰变。理论端给出的有效马约拉纳质量并非模糊区间，而是一个极其锐利的单一点值：m_ββ = 3.69 meV。
cards.threshold: 若在 1.5 meV 处探测到信号（该数值对应于完全相反的相位符号选择），说明符号选取链条出错；若信号远高于 10 meV，则本中微子质量分支失效。就 2026-07-08 冻结版所引用的上限而言，当时尚未触及检验灵敏度，更不能算作证实。
cards.note: v2.0 冻结版引用当年的实验上限处于 28 至 122 meV 之间，远高于理论点值。下一代吨级实验目标是将灵敏度下探至 1 至 10 meV 区间，正式进入该理论值的检验窗口；此外核矩阵元理论计算的不确定度也会在一定程度上展宽比对线。
cards.check: 宇宙学读出附录“马约拉纳相位发射定理”；《预言》一章预言 P2。

cards.claim: 若以框架自身的长度单位 ℓ_* 加以无量纲化，宇宙学常数写为纯数 Λ ℓ_*²。理论算得 2.93 × 10⁻¹²²，与观测值 2.89 × 10⁻¹²²（误差 1.5%）仅差 0.9 σ，其间未调节任何连续拟合参数。
cards.threshold: 若未来 Λ 的天文测定精度提升至 0.5% 而观测中心值保持不变，现有微差将瞬间放大至 2.6 σ，单凭精度即可排除这一对照关系。
cards.where: 下一代宇宙学巡天与 CMB 实验
cards.note: 该条目属于条件性比对，它依赖所选分支，且基本单位 ℓ_* 仍作为尺度基准保留。尤为关键的是：书中所算出的是一个刻画几何响应的量，将它等同于天文观测意义下的物理 Λ 这一步尚未闭合——本框架并未在此宣称解决了宇宙学常数问题。
cards.check: 勘误 E6；审阅问题 B；宇宙学读出附录“Λ 门比较注记”。

cards.claim: 刻画电磁相互作用与弱相互作用混合比例的弱混合角，由裸值 3/13 跑动算得 Z 极点处为 0.231219995；现行实测值为 0.23122 ± 0.00006。前 4 位完全吻合，后续 5 位有待未来超高精度测量检验。
cards.threshold: 若未来实验进一步收窄误差带并使中心值偏离预测，理论因无自由旋钮可调，将不得不检讨或撤回其依托的开放接口假设。
cards.where: 精密电弱测量（Z 玻色子极点）
cards.note: 该条目同样属于条件性推算，依托于作者标明的两条开放接口：其一为将结构中的两项配比正式识别为电磁力与弱力（E3），其二为将其严谨嵌入完整的标准模型体系（E8）。若该项证伪，整条电弱参数推导链均将一并失效。
cards.check: 勘误 E3、E8；审阅问题 8；《多单元》一章源头值 3/13 与剪切项 1/936。

kill.moreTitle: 专著中另列出三项证伪途径，未逐一展开为卡片：
more: 框架断言无需引入轴子。一旦在实验上确证发现 QCD 轴子，整套规范架构须彻底推倒重建。
BabyIAXO：计划约 2029 年安装磁体、2030 年后调试与取数（依工程进度而定）
框架推论质子绝对稳定。只要在实验中确证观测到一例质子衰变事例，同样须重构核心架构。
若测得张量标量比 r 达到 10⁻³ 以上量级，则当前选定的几何暴胀分支出局。
kill.today: 截至 2026-07-08 冻结版记录，上述六项检验尚无任何一项能最终证实或彻底排除对应主张：三项中微子检验中，当时引用的数据有两项微弱倾向模型侧、一项微弱偏向反面；其余三项尚待更高精度实验。所有结论均需对照最新全局拟合与新实验数据不断重检。
kill.decade: 未来十年关键检验期（2026–2035）：中微子质量顺序、CP 相位符号与 θ₂₃ 卦限将率先迎来实验判决。

machine.h2: 形式化证明器核验了什么，又没有核验什么。
machine.lead: 在 771 项带编号的定理与陈述条目中，有 727 项已通过 Lean 4 编译核验。整个代码库零 sorry，零自定义项目公理——完全没有添加任何私有公理，仅依赖 Lean 数学库标准的三条基础逻辑公理：propext、Classical.choice 与 Quot.sound。
machine.what: Lean 4 是一个极其严格的交互式定理证明检查器：只有将数学证明逐行拆解为形式化推理步骤并严丝合缝地通过编译器检验，文件才能完成编译。在 Lean 中，若某一步证明尚未完成而暂且跳过，须填入占位符 sorry；本代码库中不含任何 sorry。机器核验既不顾及审稿人的直觉印象，也不采信作者的主观信心。专著中 771 项带标签条目（包含定理、引理、命题、推论、定义与注记）已逐一经受该门禁检查。截至 2026-07-08 冻结时的完整账目为：727 项完全核验；19 项仅核验了核心推论；4 项在 Lean 代码中尚无对应条目；另有 21 项属于文字论证或经验比对，明确标为开放状态。整个语料库共涵盖 313 个模块。其中唯一的物理前置假设“存在满足条件的 K₄ 元胞”，是以显式定义参数的数据形式引入，而不隐藏在不可见的公理之中。须补充说明：这 313 个 Lean 4 模块目前仍保存在作者的工作仓库内，尚未随 2026 年公开评阅版专著一并开源；以上数字为作者统计报告，正式源码开源后方可接受学界独立的本地重新编译验证。
machine.meaning: “经 Lean 核验”仅意味着形式化推导账目清晰无误，绝不代表对应命题必然符合真实物理世界。核验断言的是逻辑结构，不是自然界。具体而言，“已核验”表明 Lean 代码中的形式化陈述与专著文字阐述在所声明的颗粒度上逻辑等价。需要留意的是，多数证书到某一步就停——当前标准数学库尚缺的细部解析环节（例如某些聚类界、连续极限过渡），均被显式写成一条点名的假设，坦诚摆在明处。用形式化证明器验证一条脱离现实的假定命题，得到的也只是基于该假定的逻辑无误推演；这些陈述能否真正刻画自然规律，仍须由上文的实验对照表与未来判决检验来回答。其余 44 项未通过核验的条目也已逐一列明具体原因。
machine.barTitle: 四类条目统计，共计 771 项。

barLabels.needsLeanNode: 尚无 Lean 对应条目

bucketsPlain.provedCoreOnly: 核心数学内核已通过机器编译检验，外围叙述语境尚未实现逐字完全形式化对位。
bucketsPlain.needsLeanNode: 专著文本中已经提出，但尚未在 Lean 代码库内编写对应的形式化节点。
bucketsPlain.proseEmpiricalOpen: 本质上属于文字物理阐释或实验数据比对，并非形式化证明器适用对象，故标注为开放。

kill.h2: This theory states which tests would force its physical claims to change.
kill.intro: These numerical claims do not use continuously fitted parameters. After a miss, a genuine derivation error must be corrected in public, or the affected claim and its dependent physical conclusions must be withdrawn. The six cards below select tests named in the manuscript. Each names who measures, which years, what counts as a miss, and the scope of the failure.
kill.registryStatus: These are the programme’s sharpest experimental bets, drawn from the manuscript. The public Registry is ready for future claims; it currently contains 0 preregistered predictions.
kill.gradeIntro: Not every miss costs the same. Three grades:
gradeKey: A confirmed inverted ordering or positive CP sign defeats the related core claim and its dependent chain; the physical realization needs review. Independent finite-system mathematics must be judged separately.
the architecture of the forces has to be rebuilt
A detected QCD axion or an observed proton decay belongs here: a fundamentally different gauge architecture would be needed.
The branch the number was read on is out; a wider framework does not automatically go with it. A double-beta signal off the point value, or the mixing angle θ₂₃ in the lower octant, belongs here.

cards.claim: Which of the three neutrinos is heaviest is computed here, not put in by hand. Two of the three lie close together in mass; the theory puts that close pair at the bottom and the odd one on top — the normal ordering — and on the branch it selects, the lightest of all is exactly massless. The inverted ordering, close pair on top, is not disfavoured inside the model: it is excluded.
cards.threshold: A confirmed inverted ordering defeats the normal-ordering claim and its dependent physical conclusions.
cards.note: JUNO began taking data in August 2025 and released first physics results that November. DUNE currently targets first far-detector operation in 2029 and beam in 2031. The global fit cited by the frozen v2.0 account leaned weakly toward normal ordering. That is a historical comparison, not a current verdict.
cards.check: Normal ordering derived on the c_R = 1 seesaw branch; the inverted-ordering exclusion theorem, cosmology readout appendix. Review Target 6.

cards.h3: The sign of the CP phase
cards.claim: Neutrinos and antineutrinos need not behave alike; one number, the CP phase δ_CP, says by how much they differ. Here it can only be +90° or −90°, and the sky settles which: this universe is made of matter, not antimatter. The sign measured in a laboratory and the sign of that leftover matter are locked together — sign(sin δ_CP) × sign(η_B) = −1, with η_B the matter the universe kept — so sin δ_CP must be negative.
cards.threshold: A measured positive sign defeats the sign-lock claim and its dependent physical conclusions.
cards.note: The theory does not derive which side came out as matter: step by step, the law is proved blind to the two, so which one this universe got is a historical fact, not a theorem. What is a theorem is the relation between the two signs, and that relation is what DUNE and Hyper-K will test. The frozen v2.0 account’s NuFIT 6.0 figures of about 214° and 1.6 σ are historical. NuFIT 6.1 gives normal-ordering best fits of 207° or 212° under its two atmospheric-data variants; both reported 3 σ ranges include 270°. This remains unsettled.
cards.check: The baryon–Dirac sign-lock theorem, internal-observer appendix; the spontaneous-orientation remark, real-vacuum chapter. Review Target C.

cards.claim: How strongly the second and third kinds of neutrino blend is set by one angle, θ₂₃. Its sin² comes out 4/7, in the upper octant — the half above 1/2.
cards.threshold: A lower octant, once settled, contradicts it.
cards.note: In the global fit cited by the frozen v2.0 account, including Super-Kamiokande atmospheric data, the best fit sat in the lower octant and the upper-octant solution remained allowed. This is a historical data status; the present octant must be checked against newer fits.
cards.check: The adjoint-carrier sign-selection lemma; the PMNS table in the predictions chapter. Review Target 6.

cards.claim: Here the neutrino is its own antiparticle, so a nucleus will occasionally emit two electrons and nothing else — no neutrinos at all. On the theory side the rate is set by one number, m_ββ. And the theory gives no range: one single point value at 3.69 meV.
cards.threshold: A signal at 1.5 meV — the value the opposite sign choice would give — falsifies the chain of signs this number rests on; one far above 10 meV puts this neutrino branch out. Under the limits cited in the frozen 2026-07-08 account, it was untested, not confirmed.
cards.note: The frozen v2.0 account cites limits of 28 to 122 meV, still far above the prediction. The next generation aims at the 1 to 10 meV layer; uncertainty in the nuclear matrix elements, how strongly a given nucleus responds, will smear that line somewhat.
cards.check: The Majorana-phase emission theorem, cosmology readout appendix; prediction P2, predictions chapter.

cards.claim: Measured in the framework’s own unit of length, ℓ_*, the cosmological constant becomes a pure number, Λ ℓ_*². Computed: 2.93 × 10⁻¹²². Observed: 2.89 × 10⁻¹²², to ±1.5%. A 0.9 σ gap, with no continuous parameter turned.
cards.threshold: A Λ measurement at 0.5% with the same central value turns that gap into 2.6 σ — and this comparison is then excluded on precision alone.
cards.note: This line is conditional. It stands on a selected branch, and ℓ_* is a unit kept as an input, not something the theory computes. What is computed is a geometric quantity — how the geometry responds — and identifying it with the Λ astronomers measure is a step the author lists as not closed. The cosmological-constant problem is not solved here.
cards.check: Erratum E6; Review Target B; the Λ-gate comparison remark, cosmology readout appendix.

cards.claim: The proportion in which electromagnetism and the weak force are mixed. Computed 0.231219995; measured 0.23122 ± 0.00006. Four digits match; the five behind them are the theory’s, written for a future measurement.
cards.threshold: If the measurement sharpens and moves, there is nothing here to turn; the only things that could give are the two open joins it rides on.
cards.note: This line is conditional too: it rides on two joins the author lists as open — that the two ingredients really are electromagnetism and the weak force, and that what the cell contains can be embedded in the full Standard Model. What would be lost is the whole electroweak chain, every number the framework computes about those two forces.
cards.check: Errata E3 and E8; Review Target 8; multi-cell chapter, the source value 3/13 and the 1/936 shear.

kill.moreTitle: Three more places it can break, listed in the manuscript but not made into cards here:
more: No axion is needed. Find one, and the architecture of the forces has to be rebuilt.
BabyIAXO: magnet installation around 2029; commissioning and axion runs from 2030+, schedule-dependent
The proton is absolutely stable. One event, and the architecture has to be rebuilt as well.
A detection at r ≳ 10⁻³, where r measures how strong those waves are, puts the selected inflation branch out.
kill.today: In the frozen 2026-07-08 account, none of the six tests had confirmed or excluded its associated claim. Of the three neutrino cards, the data cited then leaned its way on two and the other way on one; the others needed sharper experiments. New experiment results and global fits require a fresh check.
kill.decade: Ten years, on the calendar: 2026–2035. Mass ordering, the CP sign and the θ₂₃ octant are the three that get decided first, inside that window.

machine.h2: What the machine checked, and what it did not.
machine.lead: 771 labelled theorem rows, 727 of them certified in Lean 4. Zero sorry, and no axioms of its own; only the mathematical library’s three standard logical axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
machine.what: Lean 4 is a proof checker, and a very strict one: restate a theorem in a language it can check step by step, and if any step is missing its justification the whole file refuses to compile. Programmers have a word for skipping a step, sorry, meaning “I owe you this one”; this corpus contains none. It does not consult a referee’s intuition or the author’s confidence. The manuscript’s 771 labelled entries (theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries, definitions, remarks) were each put to that gate. The tally, frozen on 2026-07-08: 727 certified; 19 with only the core checked; 4 with no matching entry written in Lean yet; 21 that are prose or empirical statements and stay open. The Lean corpus runs to 313 modules. There is one physical assumption — that such a cell exists — and it enters as part of the definition, written out in the open, not as a hidden axiom. These 313 Lean 4 modules currently reside in the author’s working repository and have not yet been released in the public-review archive; the counts above are the author’s report and await independent compilation once released.
machine.meaning: “Certified” means the bookkeeping is clean, not that the physics is right. Certification is a claim about logical structure. It is not an empirical claim about nature. What it says is that the statement in Lean and the written statement in the manuscript are logically the same thing, at the level of detail the statement itself declares. Most certificates stop at a named input: the small piece of analysis the library does not yet have — a bound on clustering, a continuum limit — is written into the statement as an explicit hypothesis, in plain view rather than buried. A machine-checked proof of the wrong statement is still a proof of the wrong statement. Whether those statements describe the world correctly is what the table above is for. The remaining 44 rows are not certified, and each is labelled with the reason.

bucketsPlain.leanCertified: The Lean statement and the manuscript statement are logically equivalent at the declared level of detail, and it compiles.
bucketsPlain.provedCoreOnly: The core conclusion passed the machine; the surrounding wording is not yet matched word for word.
bucketsPlain.needsLeanNode: In the manuscript, but with nothing written to match it in Lean yet.
bucketsPlain.proseEmpiricalOpen: A prose argument or an empirical comparison by nature, not something a machine can check; marked open.

machine.barNote: 44 rows are not certified. Each carries a label saying why, in one of three kinds.
